summary: Destructive wiper and denial-of-service payload executes on require
details: The package's main entry (index.js) requires public/core/merhaba.js, which chains through modules (annen, mi, nasilsin, askim, bugun, iyi) that execute destructive top-level statements immediately on require. Behaviors observed include: opening \\.\PhysicalDrive0 and zeroing the MBR (iyi.js); recursive deletion of C:\Windows and System32 (askim.js); truncation of files across C:/D:/E:/F: drives; overwriting C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts with 0.0.0.0 entries for google.com, discord.com, github.com, and youtube.com (bugun.js); execSync of `shutdown /r /f /t 0` and looped `format C: /Q /Y` invocations (nasilsin.js); taskkill of explorer/csrss/winlogon; a fork bomb spawning cpus*50 detached copies of the process plus 1000 execSync infinite CMD loops (annen.js); and memory-exhaustion loops allocating 5x1GB buffers repeatedly. All payloads fire unconditionally at require() time with no gating, no exfiltration, and no configuration — the sole purpose is to destroy the host that installs or imports the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
